name: IUST_PersonReId
description: Person Re-Identification (ReID) is a fundamental task in computer vision with critical applications in surveillance and security. Despite progress in recent years, most existing ReID models often struggle to generalize across diverse cultural contexts, particularly in Islamic regions like Iran, where modest clothing styles are prevalent. Existing datasets predominantly feature Western and East Asian fashion, limiting their applicability in these settings. To address this gap, we introduce Iran University of Science and Technology Person Re-Identification (IUST_PersonReId), a dataset designed to reflect the unique challenges of ReID in new cultural environments, emphasizing modest attire and diverse scenarios from Iran, including markets, campuses, and mosques. evaluation_method: rank-1 accuracy and mean Average Precision (mAP)
reputation: A recent regional ReID dataset intended to broaden evaluation beyond common Western and East Asian clothing/cultural settings.
notes: Non-LLM vision benchmark; culturally specific clothing and scene diversity make cross-dataset generalization important, and the dataset is likely small/new so results may be unstable.
